liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy River Road** (1 review): Reviewer names it a highlight of the show [12]
- **Standing On The Moon** (1 review): Described as an emotional performance [12]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer says the band only found their footing at this song; before it was sloppy [13]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): The Playin' jam is called awesome, though Garcia sounds uninspired elsewhere [14]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer's standout: Bobby and Jerry nail the intro, and Garcia plays with a country twang [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd93-03-31 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd93-03-31 t02 Cold Rain & Snow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd93-03-31 t03 Wang Dang Doodle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd93-03-31 t04 Althea**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd93-03-31 t05 It's All Over Now**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd93-03-31 t06 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd93-03-31 t07 Let It Grow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd93-03-31 t08 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-03-31.139689.fob.schoeps.wise.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 145 min [1]
- **gd1993-03-31.150156.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 143 min [3]
- **gd1993-03-31.149967.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 17 songs; 143 min [4]
- **gd93-03-31.sbd.miller.18750.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 137 min; rated 2.62/5 by 8 [8]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has an odd flange-like effect on all the vocals; Vocals have a flanged or pitch-shifted quality, also noted on Charlotte and Knickerbocker shows from spring 1993; Soundboard captures Jerry picking cleanly [13][14][20]
- **gd93-03-31.soundcheck.kenk-tmnsp.31000.sbeok.flacf**: source not stated; 5 songs; 20 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [11]. Said about its sound: Soundcheck recording sounds poor, with heavy hiss suggesting an audience tape [15]

## Around the show

- First show back in the NYC area in a long while; buzz that Garcia had recovered and lost about 50 pounds [12]
- Reviewer left at the end and never saw the band again, finding Jerry in bad shape and the band going through the motions [19]
- Soundcheck material includes Cumberland Blues, Lazy River Road, and an aborted I Fought The Law before a full soundcheck take [11]
- Second set looks strong on paper but is uninspired in performance [13]
- Second set reads better than it plays; reviewer isn't sorry to have missed Nassau [14]
- Reviewer views the four-night Nassau run as a whole, with strong individual performances across nights [16]
- Reviewer attended the first three nights; solid but not as good as the Knickerbocker shows [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-03-31.139689.fob.schoeps.wise.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Jim Wise and Scott Clugston; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Jim Wise's FOB Audience DAT > Schoeps CMC6/MK4 (hand-held ORTF) > Sonosax SX-M2 > Dat (Sony D10 Pro/48k); Transfer Info: DAT Master… [1]. Also: Audience recording with Schoeps microphones, per the file name; the notes list the show's songs [1]
- **gd1993-03-31.150156.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  May 25, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [3]
- **gd1993-03-31.149967.sbd.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  May 25, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [4]
- **gd93-03-31.sbd.miller.18750.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd93-03-31.soundcheck.kenk-tmnsp.31000.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Ken K; source: Soundcheck - Unknown Source [11]. Also: Source is an unknown-generation cassette, possibly a monitor feed or tape made inside the venue; transferred and encoded by Ken K [11]
